title: Southwest Chicken Foil Packet Recipe
reject_reason: Chicken breast over black beans + corn + salsa + Mexican cheese is the same Tex-Mex baked-chicken-and-bean plate as accepted tex-mex-baked-chicken (cowboy-chicken and baked-santa-fe-chicken already rejected as the same); foil-packet vehicle is not distinguishing.
